power_cap.note: This manifest's ladder/prefill numbers ran at the vBIOS default 250 W by accident -- no per-card cap had been set that session. A same-server, no-restart re-measure at the verified 180 W club-standard cap was run 2026-09-03 and found no consistent throughput difference outside run-to-run noise. 180 W is the canonical cap; see ladder-180w.json, prefill-ttft-180w.json, and power-180w.json in this directory for the canonical numbers.

serve_config.parallelism: manual gpu_split (NOT tensor_parallel; TP raises NotImplementedError for Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration in exllamav3 1.4.6)
serve_config.drafting: disabled (n-gram speculative decoding tested, no throughput benefit)

known_limitation.summary: GLM-5.3-Flash uses DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) with index_topk=2048 (from the model's config.json). exllamav3 activates the sparse-attention path once context exceeds ~2048 tokens, and that path asserts against a quantized MLA cache: assert qc is None, "sparse DSA over a quantized MLA cache is not supported yet; use an fp16 cache". With cache_mode Q8 (the standing config), any single request whose context exceeds ~2048 tokens fails that request with a 503; the server process itself stays up.
known_limitation.workaround: cache_mode: FP16 removes the assertion and was confirmed to still fit the same gpu_split [48,48,48,48] with headroom, but was not load-tested at concurrency and is flagged as unvalidated future work, not a standing recommendation.

attempts.outcome: OOM at first inference; uneven fill left no KV-cache headroom on GPU0/1 while GPU3 stayed empty
too tight; insufficient VRAM for weights plus cache
working split; GPU3 stays under-loaded (~12 GiB vs ~48 GiB on GPU0-2), a known characteristic of exllamav3's naive sequential-fill autosplit, not a functional problem

boot_topology_note.note: Full failure ladder documented in the sibling evidence repository, not repeated here.

reasoning_finding.summary: GLM-5.3-Flash defaults to reasoning_effort: max with <think>...</think> tags in its chat template. With TabbyAPI's reasoning config left false, chain-of-thought leaks unparsed into the visible content field and burns the whole token budget with no final answer. Setting reasoning: true routes it into a separate reasoning_content field.
reasoning_finding.max_tokens_32: reproducibly not enough even with reasoning correctly parsed; the model spends the whole budget thinking and returns content: null
reasoning_finding.max_tokens_128: same prompt (capital of France, answer with just the city name) cleanly returns content: "Paris"
reasoning_finding.recommendation: max_tokens >= 128 for short factual answers with reasoning enabled

harness_note: greedy decoding, exactly 400 completion tokens, 1 warmup + 3 measured reps per concurrency level, tokens counted from the final usage object
